de.fix: Für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen und am Ende über den Anfang hinaus weiterfahren, bis die Spur ihn kreuzt.
de.help: Am Ende der Aufnahme ist der Mäher nicht in Fahrtrichtung über den Anfang der Linie gefahren. Das Stück zwischen Ende und Anfang wurde dann nie gefahren. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Anfang nicht überfahren

en.fix: For the exact edge, record again and at the end drive on past the start until the track crosses it.
en.help: At the end of the recording the mower didn't drive over the start of the line along its heading, so the piece between the end and the start was never driven. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Start not driven over

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche durchgehend vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Ein Stück der Linie liegt nicht in Fahrtrichtung des Mähers, etwa nach Rückwärtsfahren oder einem seitlichen Versatz. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Nicht in Fahrtrichtung

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward all the way.
en.help: A piece of the line doesn't follow the heading of the mower, for example after reversing or a step sideways. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Not along the heading

de.fix: Langsamer fahren und für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Zwischen zwei Punkten oder vom letzten zum ersten Punkt liegen mehr als 30 cm. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Lücke in der Linie

en.fix: Drive more slowly and record again for the exact edge.
en.help: Two points, or the last and the first point, are more than 30 cm apart. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Gap in the line

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche ohne Unterbrechung vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Die automatischen Punkte waren zwischendurch aus, Punkte wurden mit Rückgängig entfernt, oder die Position war ungenau, fehlte oder sprang. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Aufnahme unterbrochen

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward without a break.
en.help: Automatic points were off for a while, points were undone, or the position was inaccurate, missing or jumped. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Recording interrupted

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche mit automatischen Punkten vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Mindestens ein Punkt wurde von Hand gesetzt. Dann ist nicht belegt, dass der Mäher die Linie vorwärts gefahren ist. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Punkte von Hand

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward with automatic points.
en.help: At least one point was set by hand, so nothing shows that the mower drove the line forward. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Points set by hand

de.fix: Erst einige Meter geradeaus fahren, dann für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Beim Aufnehmen kannte der Mäher seine Fahrtrichtung noch nicht. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Richtung unbekannt

en.fix: Drive straight for a few metres first, then record again for the exact edge.
en.help: The mower didn't know its heading yet while recording. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Heading unknown

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche ohne Rückwärtsfahren neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Beim Aufnehmen ist der Mäher rückwärts gefahren. Die Punkte davor wurden zurückgenommen, die Linie ist dort aber nicht in einem Zug vorwärts gefahren. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Rückwärts gefahren

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again without reversing.
en.help: The mower reversed while recording. The points ahead of it were taken back, but the line wasn't driven forward in one go there. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Reversed

de.fix: Kehren als Bogen fahren und für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Die Linie knickt an einer Stelle um mehr als 120 Grad. Dort ist nicht sicher, in welche Richtung sich der Mäher gedreht hat. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Zu spitze Kehre

en.fix: Drive turns as a curve and record again for the exact edge.
en.help: The line turns by more than 120 degrees at one spot, where it isn't certain which way the mower turned. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Turn too sharp

description: robot_state, actions, events and RPC methods of MowBite OS over MQTT, as system.api gives them; made from the code, objects sorted by key. x-reasons has severity and resume of every reason by event (COMMAND_REFUSED and REQUEST_REFUSED only in refusals; when: another rating for these field values; texts: name, help and fix by language; an enum field may carry the same by value as x-texts), x-emergency-bits the bits of emergency, x-commands the commands with params, result, the event of their refusal and the actions that do the same, x-methods every RPC method of the OS with its node (planner.* are the planner's, sim.* only in the simulation), x-sensors the sensors by id, x-settings the settings of params.set with the ranges of the OS, x-geometry the keys of robot.geometry, x-schedule-log the words of schedule.log with what detail and more hold (null: always null).

calibration.result.description: The result of the last calibration, null before one

camera.list.description: The cameras of the mower; CAMERA_CHANGED tells when one of them can stream again or no longer, or streams with other protocols or at another size

camera.stream.description: Keeps a place for one viewer and gives the address to watch from: for one connection, which has to begin before expires; the place is free again when that connection ends, and every new connection needs a new call. At most two viewers at once over all cameras (CAMERA_BUSY). mjpeg: a GET of url gives multipart/x-mixed-replace, every part one JPEG with its own Content-Length, and every answer to that GET, also a refusal, carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; webrtc: url is a WHEP endpoint (H.264). Refused (CAMERA_REFUSED) while the camera is not available; -32602 for an id or a protocol it does not have

docking.start.description: Drives home from IDLE to the docking station where the OS docks by itself; offered only there
docking.start.offered: only where the OS docks by itself

emergency.reset.description: Asks the safety node to release the emergency and answers with its answer, after at most 3 s

events.history.description: The events of one local day as events/json sent them

events.history.delete.description: Deletes the events of one day, without a day of all

host.restart_os.description: Starts MowBite OS again, its restarts from 0: always when it is stopped, down or halted, else only in IDLE without an emergency or the restart hold; never during an update. The restart hold judges at the start as always

light.get_profile.description: The lights: the states and effects there are, the profile by state, its defaults, the fixed signal of an emergency and the limits

light.preview.description: Shows an effect for a while, then the state again; an emergency shows over it

light.reset.description: Back to the default profile; ends a preview

light.set_profile.description: Stores the profile, all or nothing; a state left out gets its default

logs.recent.description: The last log lines from WARN on, oldest first, logins hidden

map.area_properties.description: The properties an area of the map may have

map.replace.description: Replaces the map with the one given, in the shape of map/json

mowing.abort.description: Ends mowing; the mower goes home where it docks by itself

mowing.continue.description: Continues mowing after a pause that waits for the user

mowing.plan.description: Asks the planner for the paths of an area without mowing it

mowing.reset_job.description: Drops the unfinished job in IDLE

mowing.start.description: Starts or continues the job of mowing from IDLE

ntrip.get.description: The access to the caster for corrections, without user and password

ntrip.set.description: Stores the access in IDLE, all or nothing; a stored login stays only for the same host and port

params.set.description: Changes settings of x-settings in IDLE, all or nothing; a value outside its range is set to the bound

position.history.description: The track of a job of mowing

position.history.delete.description: Deletes the track of a job, without a job all but the current one

recording.auto_points.description: Switches the automatic points of the ring on or off

recording.discard.description: Drops what was recorded and not saved

recording.dock.description: Records a point of the docking station: first in front of it, then on the contacts; DOCK_RECORDED follows

recording.exit.description: Leaves the recording; what was not saved is gone

recording.point.description: Takes the next position as a point of the ring

recording.ring_start.description: Starts recording a ring: the outline, after it an obstacle

recording.ring_stop.description: Closes the ring being recorded; one without points just ends, one whose end ran past its start is cut at the crossing

recording.save.description: Saves the outline and its obstacles as an area, closing an open ring first; AREA_RECORDED follows

recording.start.description: Enters the recording of areas from IDLE

recording.undo.description: Takes points back from the end of the open ring and switches the automatic points off; the mower stays

robot.geometry.get.description: The dimensions of the mower, keys of x-geometry

robot.geometry.set.description: Changes dimensions in IDLE, all or nothing; GEOMETRY_CHANGED follows

rpc.methods.description: The methods offered right now, of the OS and the planner

schedule.get.description: The schedule, whether it may start, the clock and the sun

schedule.leftovers.description: The leftovers after a job: enabled 1 is refused (-32602 unsupported) until the planner prepares them on the OS

schedule.log.description: The log of the schedule, oldest first; words in x-schedule-log

schedule.set.description: Changes keys of the schedule, all or nothing: -32602 with data {field, reason}, -32001 when version is not the one of the last schedule.get

sensors.list.description: Every sensor of sensor_infos/json with its last value; ids selects some, unknown ids are left out

sound.delete.description: Deletes the upload of a situation, so that the vendor's sound plays again, or none without one; nothing to delete is no error. -32004 while an update holds the mower
sound.delete.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.list.description: The situations the OS has a sound for, the sound of each and the volume
sound.list.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.play.description: Plays the sound of a situation once, to listen to it; refused (SOUND_REFUSED) in an emergency and without a sound (NO_FILE)
sound.play.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.stop.description: Ends the sound that plays; refused (SOUND_REFUSED) in an emergency
sound.stop.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.upload.description: Uploads an MP3 of at most 2 MB and 30 s for a situation in parts, one upload at a time, also in an emergency; part 0 starts it, the same file from part 0 starts it again. The OS checks it after the last part and only then plays it instead of the vendor's sound. Refused (SOUND_REFUSED) for a wrong file, order or size and while another upload runs; an unfinished upload is dropped 60 s after its last part; -32004 while an update holds the mower
sound.upload.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.volume.description: Reads the volume, or sets it with volume; 0 is silent, also in an emergency. A change while an update holds the mower is refused with -32004
sound.volume.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

system.api.description: This interface as JSON Schema with its version

system.hold.description: Holds the mower for an update: granted only in IDLE with nothing on its way and no start of the schedule within 1800 s, 0 lets go

system.info.description: Name, version and platform of the OS with the versions of its data and of this interface

system.stats.description: Memory, disks, load, temperature, uptime and network of the machine the OS runs on, with the keys and units of system.cgi of the app; a value that cannot be read is left out

update.abort.description: Stops the update before its switch; after it the health check decides

update.check.description: Looks for bundles in the origins now (the inbox), as it does every 6 h

update.rollback.description: Goes back to the previous installation through the same gate, planner and app without an own one before to the bundled one, the host to its seed in the rootfs; that revision is then not installed by itself. NO_PREVIOUS on the bundled one or the seed

update.set_auto.description: Switches the automatic update on or off and sets its window; it needs an app as new as min_app. It takes the switch also without a sure clock, only the update in the window waits for one

update.start.description: Installs the newest available revision of the component or the one given, one update at a time; os and planner wait for the gate (IDLE on the charging contacts, the hold granted) for up to 30 min, the planner also for the end of the mowing job, the app and the host for none. The host starts itself anew and gives the result once the new one confirmed itself after 60 s, else it goes back. Refused (UPDATE_REFUSED) when none is there or one runs

update.status.description: What the updater does and what is there; the same retained on mowbite/update/status
